info.description: HL7 FHIR API for List resource. Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/Davinci-drug-formulary/StructureDefinition/usdf-CoveragePlan]
info.title: List

parameters.name: _profile
parameters.description: Select resources based on a given HL7 profile.

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: Select resource based on the logical `id`.

parameters.name: _lastUpdated
parameters.description:
Select resources based on the last time they were changed.

- Only date is supported in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.
- Prefixes supported are `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge` and `le`. Refer to their definitions at http://hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix.

eg: `_lastUpdated=eq2021-01-14`

500.description: Internal server error - please contact the API provider

503.description: Service unavailable - please contact the API provider
